templates.nl_query: Riverside houses close to good schools.
templates.sql: SELECT "p"."address_street", "p"."address_postal_code", "s"."school_name", "stp"."proximity_miles" FROM "real_estate"."properties" AS "p" JOIN "real_estate"."cities" AS "c" ON "p"."city_id" = "c"."city_id" JOIN "real_estate"."school_to_property" AS "stp" ON "p"."property_id" = "stp"."property_id" JOIN "real_estate"."schools" AS "s" ON "stp"."school_id" = "s"."school_id" WHERE "c"."city_name" = 'Riverside' AND "s"."school_ranking" <= 5 AND "stp"."proximity_miles" <= 2 ORDER BY 0.8 * "s"."school_ranking" + 0.2 * "stp"."proximity_miles"
templates.intent: Riverside houses close to good schools.
templates.manifest: A given city houses close to good schools.

parameterized.parameterized_sql: SELECT "p"."address_street", "p"."address_postal_code", "s"."school_name", "stp"."proximity_miles" FROM "real_estate"."properties" AS "p" JOIN "real_estate"."cities" AS "c" ON "p"."city_id" = "c"."city_id" JOIN "real_estate"."school_to_property" AS "stp" ON "p"."property_id" = "stp"."property_id" JOIN "real_estate"."schools" AS "s" ON "stp"."school_id" = "s"."school_id" WHERE "c"."city_name" = $1 AND "s"."school_ranking" <= 5 AND "stp"."proximity_miles" <= 2 ORDER BY 0.8 * "s"."school_ranking" + 0.2 * "stp"."proximity_miles"

value_searches.query: /* Requires extension: pg_trgm */ WITH TrigramMetrics AS (SELECT T.municipality_name AS original_value, (T.municipality_name % $value::text) AS normalized_dist FROM real_estate.municipalities T WHERE T.municipality_name % $value::text) SELECT original_value AS value, 'real_estate.municipalities.municipality_name' AS columns, 'Name of the municipality' AS concept_type, normalized_dist AS distance, ''::text AS context FROM TrigramMetrics

/* Requires extension: pg_trgm */ WITH TrigramMetrics AS (SELECT T.city_name AS original_value, (T.city_name % $value::text) AS normalized_dist FROM real_estate.cities T WHERE T.city_name % $value::text) SELECT original_value AS value, 'real_estate.cities.city_name' AS columns, 'Name of the city' AS concept_type, normalized_dist AS distance, ''::text AS context FROM TrigramMetrics

/* Requires extension: pg_trgm */ WITH TrigramMetrics AS (SELECT T.brokerage AS original_value, (T.brokerage % $value::text) AS normalized_dist FROM real_estate.agents T WHERE T.brokerage % $value::text) SELECT original_value AS value, 'real_estate.agents.brokerage' AS columns, 'Name of the brokerage' AS concept_type, normalized_dist AS distance, ''::text AS context FROM TrigramMetrics
